evidenceNotes: Lifetime goal: 250,000 overall reported video views by December 31 Eastern. Known total 146,572; historical coverage is not campaign growth.

89 public measured records plus seven private/unlisted YouTube records in aggregate: 96 measured posts. Four new Knife links verified; only YouTube and TikTok have saved numeric counters. Knife Instagram is unknown and X is excluded from headline totals. Earlier inventory dates remain; this was a focused review refresh.

Focused native publication and four-hour review observations around 4:00-4:07 PM Eastern updated only the named posts. Full inventory observations remain dated around 3:49-3:52 PM; component times stay separate.

Focused post updates changed the prior saved campaign total by +152. Opening-cohort counters retain their earlier collection dates. No full inventory refresh, organic attribution or winning format is claimed.

The fixed opening baseline is 14,895 YouTube Shorts views and 13,337 Instagram Reel views, measured at 2:51-2:53 AM Eastern. The 23-minute start-to-baseline gap remains unmeasured. Negative native corrections are retained.

Anubis is verified public on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X and Ko-fi. Lab File 003 is public on YouTube. The common planned release was 12:05 PM Eastern; native precision and processing vary. Ko-fi shows only a date, so its exact publication time is unknown.
Ko-fi Anubis remains a historical publication record; no additional Ko-fi posts are scheduled. Planned times are not actual publication times.

Owned Twitch, FACEIT and OBS source indexing remains incomplete. Editing approval used documented sampled visual and technical audio checks; unavailable listening or continuous playback is not claimed. Local operations require this PC online with Codex open.

Current campaign allocation is reconciled: 13 occupied posts and four queued reservations use all 17 slots within the documented campaign scope. Three retired public experiments remain in historical records. The four Door posts announce tonight's recorded showcase; Next Corner posts are drafts. New scheduling is paused because capacity is full.

Four stream preview posts were provider-marked published at 4:45–4:48 PM Eastern on X, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, and all four have now been verified on their native public pages. The TikTok preview is https://www.tiktok.com/@iananthonyfc/video/7695514908397440269. No new teaser view counts are claimed here.

Five due four-hour reviews completed, all inconclusive. Anubis and episode retain 24/72/168-hour checks. Knife has new publication-based review jobs; actual times differ slightly across platforms. Ko-fi exact publication time remains unavailable and has a separate observation review.

Instagram followers remain the dated 73 observation. Retention and engagement findings are shown in the review log with their own timestamps. Unknown counters are not zero; X views remain outside headline growth.
